_notes.schema: Per KPI: key (stable id), label/label_en, aliases (old labels still accepted by the baselines route), parquet, unit/unit_en/unit_kind (count|percent_rate|per_mille_rate|currency), source_code/source_title(_en), definition(_en), measure additive|non_additive, partitions = columns collapsed (declared complete disjoint partitions, FIX-02 declared_partitions), weights = aligned weight parquet for non-additive measures, allow_approximation = permit a named unweighted mean when no weights exist, suppress = reason the KPI is not shown.
_notes.unemployment: SOM103A has only Masculin/Feminin rows and no weights (labour force by sex is not available), so the combined figure is an unweighted mean of the two sex rates: a named approximation, never the official total.
_notes.wage: FOM106E has no all-activities total row; the previous config filtered ECON_ACTIVITY IS NULL, which matches no rows, so the card never appeared. It is now explicitly suppressed.
_notes.rates: Birth/death rates are published for Urban/Rural only; they are combined with POP105A resident-population weights per residence area and year (so periods before POP105A starts in 2012 are not shown).
